Set the thinking level

Gemini models think before they answer. The thinking level controls how much internal reasoning the model spends before producing visible output. Use a lower level for latency-sensitive work and a higher level for hard problems.

ModelDefault ThinkingLevels Supported
gemini-3.1-pro-previewOn (high)low, medium, high
gemini-3-flash-previewOn (high)low, medium, high
gemini-3-pro-previewOn (high)low, high
gemini-3.5-flashOn (medium)low, medium, high
gemini-2.5-proOnlow, medium, high
gemini-2.5-flashOnlow, medium, high
gemini-2.5-flash-liteOfflow, medium, high

Thinking can be disabled on models that allow it; some models (the pro tier) always think. The level vocabulary is shared across the 3.x and 2.5 model generations now that the numeric thinkingBudget knob has been retired.
